description: DataPacks are the Australian Bureau of Statistics' bulk download of Census of Population and Housing results. Each pack holds one community profile for every area of a chosen census geography, from all of Australia down to Statistical Area Level 1, with CSV tables, metadata workbooks and the matching digital boundaries. The General Community Profile covers persons, families and dwellings by place of usual residence, including dwelling structure, tenure, number of bedrooms, motor vehicles per dwelling and household internet access; the Working Population Profile counts employed people at their place of work with industry, occupation and method of travel to work; there are also Time Series (2011, 2016, 2021), Place of Enumeration and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander profiles. The ABS produces the census every five years to support planning and funding. Format and access: zip files from the DataPacks page without registration (the 2021 General Community Profile for all geographies is 584 MB); custom cross-tabulations need TableBuilder, which requires registration. Licence: ABS website material is under CC BY 4.0, free; unit record microdata is excluded. Caveats: the time series profile recasts earlier censuses to 2021 classifications and the ABS warns that changes in form design, collection and processing affect comparability; census geographies change between censuses. Simulation uses: residential exposure and population at risk for hazards, daytime worker populations for evacuation and transport demand, and agent-based population synthesis. Related records: IPUMS International census microdata, the WorldPop gridded population and the Australian water account.
